RejectedHeadingCandidates: Google SSO System : Handles user authentication via OAuth 2.0. APE sends Login Initiation Requests and Token Verification Requests; receives Authentication Responses.

Judge0 API (Docker) : The external code execution engine. APE sends Executable Source Code, Input Arrays, and Execution Constraints; receives Standard Outputs, Compilation & Error Logs, and Runtime Metrics.

LLM Cloud Service (OpenAI / Google Gemini): Provides AI capabilities. APE sends Clean Text Chunks, Contextual Prompts, and Generation Requests; receives Generated Practice Contents, AI Comments, Contextual Hints, and Vector Embeddings.
OCR Cloud Service: Processes raw uploaded documents. APE sends Raw Course Materials; receives Extracted Text Strings.
Payment API: Handles financial transactions for p urchase credits . APE sends QR Generation Requests; receives Payment Status confirmations.

Key design decisions: No time limit is enforced — this is a learning tool, not an exam simulator. In Practice mode, once an answer is selected it cannot be changed, ensuring students engage seriously with each question. In Flashcard mode, no automated grading occurs; students self-report their memorization status (BR-45). Upon completion, the system displays a summary with per-topic breakdown, and all results are persisted in PracticeSession.fe_answers[] for downstream analytics (Workflow 1.2.5 feeds data into UC-10 Competency Chart and UC-11 AI Study Advice).

Flow: Redirect from FE Generation → Load PracticeSession + Questions → Branch by display mode → [Practice] Show question → Select answer → Check correctness → Highlight + Show explanation → Auto-save → Repeat → Summary (X/Y correct, per-topic breakdown) → [Flashcard] Show question card → Flip → Self-assess → Auto-save → Repeat → Summary (X/Y memorized) → Update PracticeSession status = "Completed" → Return to Dashboard or Generate new exam.

External AI provider (Google Gemini / OpenAI). Tier 1 handles fast tasks (Gatekeeper, Tagging, FE Generation). Tier 2 handles deep reasoning (PE Generation, Code Mentor). Receives prompts + context; returns generated content.
Admin assigns LLM models to task tiers: Tier 1 (fast/cheap) for Gatekeeper, Tagging, FE Generator; Tier 2 (deep reasoning) for PE Generator, AI Code Review.
Samples 1,000–2,000 tokens from extracted text, sent to LLM Tier 1 for classification. Returns {is_supported, reason}.
RAG query → LLM Tier 1 generates MCQ JSON → Critic reviews → retry max 2 → JSON schema validation → store to QuestionsBank (type=FE) → serve to PracticeSession (mode: Practice or Flashcard).
Generator creates {Problem, Skeleton, Solution, Inputs, Hints} → Critic review (retry ≤2) → Judge0 executes to produce Outputs (retry ≤2).
On-demand (max 2/session). Packages {Problem + Code + Logs}, sent to LLM Tier 2 for analysis. Returns conceptual hints (no solution code).
